svg.text: Subsystem Latency & Execution Distribution
992.0 ns Token Decode Execution Partitioning across Architecture Layers
1. Analog IMC Compute (900.0 ns / 90.7%)
• Primary Evidence: SPICE + Derived (t_tile = 100 ns)
• 9 Sequential Crossbar Passes: W_QKV, W_O, W_up, W_down, W_head
• Full spatial weight residency across 416 physical tiles
• Zero DRAM stalls: Weights remain permanently in memristor cells
Latency: 900.0 ns (90.7% of Total Token Time)
2. Digital SIMD Vector Units (80.0 ns / 8.1%)
• Primary Evidence: Derived (5 ns / pipelined vector op @ 200 MHz)
• LayerNorm 1, 2, Final LayerNorm (FP32/INT8 arithmetic)
• Attention Softmax & Dynamic Q·K^T dot product matrix
• Digital GELU element-wise activation + Residual Additions
Latency: 80.0 ns (8.1% of Total Token Time)
3. On-Chip SRAM Pool (2.0 ns / 0.2%)
• Primary Evidence: Derived (28nm standard cell SRAM model)
• Token Embedding lookup (128 vocab × 64 dim)
• KV Cache buffer read/write access (32 KB capacity)
• Inter-stage intermediate activation buffering
Latency: 2.0 ns (0.2% of Total Token Time)
4. NoC Mesh Interconnect (6.0 ns / 0.6%)
• Primary Evidence: Assumed (3.0 ns / router hop)
• 2 Inter-Cluster hops: Attention cluster to SRAM buffer
• 128-bit flit width, single-cycle router arbitration
• Fully decoupled from analog tile execution
Latency: 6.0 ns (0.6% of Total Token Time)
